Resubmitted with the duration contradiction repaired.

**What changed this round (new operation 2, §17(a)):**
- The words "and the license granted under this Agreement" are struck from §17(a), so the fee-payment/termination condition now governs only the term of the Agreement, and one short sentence is added: "The licence granted under Section 2 survives expiry or termination of this Agreement." This removes the revocation mechanic that negated "perpetual" and "irrevocable" in §2, with no separate survival tail or other boilerplate added.
- Coherence check on retained mechanics: §18 survival remains intact and unaffected; §17(c) conversion to a perpetual, fee-free licence on Garman's default (p0128) is consistent with, not contradicted by, the new survival sentence; §17(b) cease-use only bites if **we** elect to terminate, so it is left untouched as our own election; the "Authorized Locations" definition is still used in §4(a)–(b) and Schedule "C", so no dangling reference results from deleting the §2 place-of-use cap.

**Coverage at fallback:** Vendor ownership of the Work already met (§13, p0088); perpetual and irrevocable now carried by operations 1 and 2; worldwide, royalty-free, use/modify by operation 1; sublicense by operations 1 and 3 (§3(c) conformance); Customer Data processing limitation by operation 4 (new §4(c)). Preferred is not pursued — it would require Garman to assign the Software and an affirmative data-ownership sentence, which is beyond the fallback we have accepted here.
